scripts.build: npm run build -w @lethalmagotchi/shared && npm run build -w @lethalmagotchi/server && npm run build -w @lethalmagotchi/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lethalmagotchi/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lethalmagotchi/shared" "npm run dev -w @lethalmagotchi/server" "npm run dev -w @lethalmagotchi/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lethalmagotchi/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
